stories.title: 7 tips for achieving defensive agility
stories.why: Defensive security agility reflects an organization’s potential to rapidly detect, adapt, and respond to evolving cyber threats and vulnerabilities without disrupting core operations.

stories.title: Debian, Ubuntu patch APT flaw that could hand attackers root
stories.why: Linux administrators’ trust in package managers is being tested by a newly disclosed vulnerability in APT, the package management system used by Debian, Ubuntu, and their derivatives, that could allow attackers to…

stories.title: CrowdStrike’s AI SOC vision evolves as agentic uncertainty adds new twist
stories.why: “The software we use has become an actor,” declared CrowdStrike President Michael Sentonas in his address on the dangers and opportunity of agentic AI at the company’s Fal.Con conference in September.

stories.title: CPython flaw exposes AI inference servers to sandbox escape attacks
stories.why: A memory-safety flaw in CPython can allow malicious AI model templates to escape code sandboxes and execute arbitrary code inside inference servers, according to security researchers at RunSybil.

stories.title: An average of 8 minutes is all hackers need to log in with stolen credentials
stories.why: Attackers used stolen credentials to log in an average of eight minutes after infection across 27 confirmed infostealer cases, according to a report from Elastic Security Threat Command.

stories.title: Taiwan-Based Hacker Used BOSSAI AI Agents to Steal Taipei Emergency Dispatch Records
stories.why: A single attacker using AI agents pulled emergency dispatch records covering seven Taipei districts, researchers at Acronis's Threat Research Unit said last week.

stories.title: Trio accused of using deepfake CEOs and bogus lawyers to scam businesses out of $129 million
stories.why: Three men allegedly used deepfakes of company CEOs and law firm attorneys to trick employees into wiring more than $129 million to accounts the group controlled, the Justice Department said.

stories.title: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI finds 81 Firefox flaws, 948 Linux bugs
stories.why: OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new artificial intelligence model that has discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws.

stories.title: Linus Torvalds sees signs AI-prompted patch flood has peaked
stories.why: Fixes are arriving faster than new bug reports for one major Linux project
